page.layout: One printed page, one column of Hebrew lexicon entries, with the page number at top left and the running head at top centre-right. The signature "K 4" stands at the foot.

main_text.l: עָנָב m. Amator, Amasius: plur. עֲנָבִים.
עוֹגָב, עָגַב m. Organum, ab Amabili sone.
עָגוֹל עָגַל m. Rotundum, plur. f. עֲגֻלּוֹת.
עָגִיל m. Inauris, rotunda proprie: plurale, עֲגִילִים.
מַעְגָּל m. Plaustrorum-ambitus: Orbita, via plaustralis: plur. מַעְגָּלִים & מַעְגְּלוֹת.
עגן Niphal נֶעְגַּן Retardari, Retardare se.
עָדַד Pihel עוֹדֵד Statuminare. Hithpahel הִתְעוֹדֵד Statuminari, Velut, Statuminatum consistere.
עָדָה Ornare, Ornare seipsum: item, Transfire.
Praeter. עֲדַת כְּנָךְ Discedit ate, Dan. 4.28.
Futur. יַעְדֶּה Praeterit. Dan.7.14: לָא תֶעְדָא

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some entries are small and worn; several vocalisations (marked by the scan's faintness) are read as best possible and may contain errors. The top running head is doubtful. The page carries no catchword. Stray marks at the foot and edges are not transcribed.
